sources.title: Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2012, results by county (Kansas City listed as its own jurisdiction) (pdf)
Missouri Secretary of State, Official Election Returns, General Election 2012, statewide totals (pdf)

method: Kansas City (Kansas City Board of Election Commissioners, the Jackson County part of the city) Governor votes transcribed from the official county-by-county returns PDF (text extracted with pdftotext; PDFs kept in data/raw/state/2012_MO_SEN_kc/) into one row added to Jackson County 29095; oth = Higgins (Libertarian) 3,056, write-ins 0. Needed because Amlani & Algara's Missouri 2012 Governor county rows omit Kansas City (statewide shortfall equals Kansas City exactly).
validation: Amlani statewide dem 1,386,582 + KC 107,474 = 1,494,056 vs certified Jeremiah W. (Jay) Nixon 1,494,056: +0 (+0.00%); Amlani statewide rep 1,136,459 + KC 23,806 = 1,160,265 vs certified David (Dave) Spence 1,160,265: +0 (+0.00%). KC row sums to the official KC total of 134,336.
